subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` adopt reattach-and-cache-replay before its current automatic isolated embedded fallback after an ambiguous accepted Gateway disconnect?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the public default behavior on a compatibility-sensitive failure path; source tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the latency, output, and duplicate-side-effect policy.

options.title: Approve bounded reattach-first recovery
options.body: Adopt wait plus cache-only replay before the existing isolated fallback, provided final-head proof covers both recovered and exhausted outcomes.

options.title: Keep immediate isolated fallback
options.body: Retain the current fallback ordering and limit follow-up work to containment or diagnostics rather than changing the disconnect policy.

options.title: Split policy from implementation
options.body: Keep this PR paused while the canonical issue records the intended CLI contract, then rebase the implementation to that decision.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded reattach-first recovery
recommendation.body: Adopt wait plus cache-only replay before the existing isolated fallback, provided final-head proof covers both recovered and exhausted outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged fresh-session fallback work is the direct current-main baseline for this policy choice.
